title: Berlin Friedrichstraße Utopia 2048
lede: A bird’s-eye matte painting of central Berlin in 2048: terraced green hills over the railway, solar roofs, canals for swimming and solar boats, and an airship in a clear sky.
summary: Aerial painting of a planted, solar-roofed Berlin around Friedrichstraße station. Aerroscape and Lino Zeddies, 2023.

evidence.note: Downloaded and inspected the [Commons copy](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Berlin_Friedrichstra%C3%9Fe_Utopia_2048_small_file.jpg) (original 7098 × 5315 px, viewed at 1600 × 1198 px).

styles.note: A wide daylit solarpunk city: planted terraces, solar roofs, a turbine-topped tower, rail, bicycles, and clean water, in bright green and sky blue.

context: Realutopien, a project of Reinventing Society e. V., publishes the image as “Berlin Friedrichstraße Utopia 2048 by Lino Zeddies & Aerroscape, CC BY-SA 4.0”, with other “Utopia 2048” views by Aerroscape (Singapore, Landleben, Vehlefanz). [Realutopien](https://realutopien.info/visuals/berlin-friedrichstrasse-utopia-2048/).

The Commons upload is dated 6 May 2023 and describes “a futuristic, sustainable Berlin - with lots of solar power, trees and greenery, airships, walkable streets, clean water”. A Commons reviewer confirmed the license on 7 October 2023. [Commons file page](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Berlin_Friedrichstra%C3%9Fe_Utopia_2048_small_file.jpg).
observed: The view looks east over Bahnhof Friedrichstraße, whose arched train shed carries blue solar panels. The Fernsehturm stands on the horizon.
A hill of stepped, planted terraces with buildings rises behind the station. Two towers in the distance are wrapped in trees.
At right, a tall slab is clad in solar panels and planting and carries two vertical-axis wind turbines on its roof.
The Spree runs through the foreground with swimmers, a small solar boat, and steps down to the water. Streets are full of pedestrians, cyclists, and market stalls, with no cars visible.
Arched pedestrian bridges, a monorail-like train, an airship marked “art by aerroscape”, and a hot-air balloon fill the scene.
The palette is saturated leaf green and clear sky blue, with cream and terracotta buildings. The rendering is a detailed, semi-realistic digital painting, not outlined.
interpretation: The painting shows the architectural branch of solarpunk: an existing city retrofitted, not replaced. Historic buildings stay, and green and solar layers grow over them.
Its realistic matte-painting finish differs from the outlined, flat illustration in the style’s core, but its colour and content match the grammar closely.
borrow: Use a high, wide viewpoint over a recognizable place to show change at city scale.
Keep the existing landmarks and add planting, solar roofs, and water access around them.

images.alt: Aerial painting of Berlin with a solar-roofed Friedrichstraße station, a terraced green hill, a river with swimmers and solar boats, crowds of cyclists and walkers, the TV tower on the skyline, and an airship in a blue sky.
images.caption: Aerroscape and Lino Zeddies, “Berlin Friedrichstraße Utopia 2048”, 2023. Existing Berlin buildings appear as part of the painted cityscape.
